text:
## [SECTION 4: Gehrah Mein Dooba]

Mera dil zor se dhadak raha tha aur paseene ki boondein mere maathe par aane lagi thin. Ek vanrakshak hone ke naate mujhe pata tha ki is tarah ki jagahon par rukna ya peeche hatna dono hi khatarnak ho sakte hain. Lekin us pal meri buddhi par uska sawaal haavi ho gaya tha ki agar main yahan se mud gaya toh kya hoga. Mere dimaag mein Vikram ki wo chetawni baar-baar goonj rahi thi lekin mere pairon ne kadam aage badhane ka faisla kar liya tha. Mujhe us jhadiyon ke peeche maujood us awaaz ka raaz jaan na tha. Main dhire-dhire us taraf badha jahan se meri apni hi cheekh sunayi de rahi thi. Mere haath thar-thara rahe the aur mera saans phool raha tha kyunki har kadam ke saath jungle ki mitti aur sadti hui pattiyon ki mehak mere naak mein bhar rahi thi. Har ek kadam par mujhe lag raha tha ki koi meri taraf dekh raha hai lekin jab main mudkar dekhta toh sirf ghani jhadiyan hi dikhti thin.

Jaise-jaise main us point ke kareeb pahuncha jahan se awaaz aa rahi thi, maahol mein ek ajeeb badlav mehsoos hone laga. Jungle ki wo rozana ki shor-sharaba jo ab tak mere kaano mein pad rahi thi woh achanak bilkul khatam ho gayi. Keede-makode jo raat bhar jhingur ki tarah awaaz karte hain aur pakshi jo door kahin udte hain, sab kuch ek pal mein khamosh ho gaya. Aisa lag raha tha jaise kisi ne poore jungle ka sound switch off kar diya ho. Yeh wo sannata nahi tha jo kudrat deti hai balki ye ek maut jaisi khamoshi thi jisne mere darr ko dugna kar diya. Mere apne qadmon ki aawaz bhi ab mujhe bahut zyada tez lag rahi thi jaise koi unhe door se sun raha ho. Meri saansein tez ho gayi aur mera har ek movement dhyan se karne ki koshish mein badal gaya.

Tabhi wo awaaz phir se shuru hui par is baar kuch alag thi. Woh recording ya voice note ab ek single loop mein nahi chal raha tha balki usmein jaise kai awaazein ek saath mil rahi thin. Meri hi awaaz, meri hi tadap aur mere hi saans phoolne ki aawazein ek doosre ke upar parat dar (layer) ban rahi thin. Aisa lag raha tha jaise koi purana record player kharab ho gaya ho jahan se ek hi awaaz kai alag-alag waqt par sunai de rahi ho. Kuch hisson mein meri awaaz saaf thi aur kuch mein wo itni distorted thi ki samajh nahi aa raha tha ki main kya keh raha hoon. Ye awaazein ab sirf mere peeche ya aage se nahi balki har taraf se, upar se aur niche se lag rahi thin jaise koi invisible circle mere charon taraf bana hua ho.

Isi beech meri nazar un jhadiyon par padi jahan se ye sab shuru ho raha tha. Wahan ki parchhaiyan (shadows) ajeeb tarah se hil rahi thin. Hawa bilkul nahi chal rahi thi lekin pedon ke peeche wali parchhayiyan aise hil rahi thin jaise koi unke andar chhupa hua ho. Kuch parchhaiyan us disha mein mud rahi thin jahan koi darakht ya rasta nahi tha. Meri aankhon ne dekha ki ek badi si parchayi dhire se jhadiyon ke beech se nikal kar ek purane ped ki taraf badh rahi thi. Woh movement itni smooth aur natural nahi thi balki aisa lag raha tha jaise koi frame-by-frame move kar raha ho jo kisi insani fitrat ke khilaf tha. Mera dimaag mujhe keh raha tha ki bhago, par meri aankhein us ajeeb harkat ko dekhne se ruk nahi paa rahi thin.

Tabhi ek aisi awaaz aayi jisne mere shareer mein ek jhatka dauda diya. Meri hi cheekh, bilkul waisi hi jaise main tab chilla paata agar koi mujh par hamla karta, wo us ped ke andar se aa rahi thi. Wo awaaz kisi mike ya speaker se nahi balki lag raha tha jaise lakdi ke andar se goonj rahi ho. Maine dekha ki woh purana aur sookha hua darakht thoda sa kaanp raha tha jaise koi usey andar se hila raha ho. Meri khud ki cheekh us ped ke tana (trunk) ke andar se gunji aur uske baad ek bhayankar khamoshi cha gayi. Mujhe ehsas hua ki ye koi recording nahi hai balki kuch aisi cheez hai jo mere waqt aur meri pehchan ko chura rahi hai. Mere dil ki dharkan itni tez ho gayi ki mujhe apne kaano mein apna hi khoon daudte hue sunayi dene laga.

Ab darr ne kab mere dimaon par kabza kar liya pata nahi chala. Jaise-jaise suraj doob raha tha aur andhera gehra ho raha tha, wo "echoes" yaani goonjti hui awaazein tezi se badhne lagi. Har kadam jo main peeche ki taraf leta, meri ek purani baat yahan dobara sunai deti. Meri subah ki baatein, mere din bhar ke faisle, sab kuch ab us jungle mein gunjne lage. Aisa lag raha tha jaise ye jungle mere ateet (past) ko capture kar raha ho aur usey dubara chala raha ho. Main bhagte hue apni jeep ki taraf nikal pada lekin har mod par mujhe apni hi purani awaazein sunayi de rahi thin. Wo awaazein ab tez hoti ja rahi thin aur unka shor mere kaano mein chubhne laga tha. Mujhe samajh aa gaya tha ki agar main yahan ek pal aur ruka, toh ye "echoes" mujhe hamesha ke liye nigal lengi.
summary: Aryan ko apni hi voice notes ki gaur-goonj sunai deti hai jo badalte hue aur overlapping hone lagti hain, aur usse ehsas hota hai ki koi cheez uske past ko repeat kar rahi hai. Wo ek ajeeb darakht se apni hi cheekh sunte hue darr ke maare peeche hatne ki koshish karta hai jaise-jaise andhera badhta hai aur "echoes" tez hoti hain.
